jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Organization Summary**

Since 1987, the Conservation Corps of Long Beach (CCLB) has worked to help youth realize their potential while serving the Gateway Cities area. As a state-certified Corps, CCLB is positioned to offer its Corpsmembers access to a variety of environmental work experiences while also facilitating personal development opportunities. More than 12,000 youth and young adults have benefitted from our unique program, and over 1,500 have received a high school diploma while working with us. We continue to serve local youth as we work towards achieving our vision of a world where all youth and young adults thrive, are resilient, have equitable access to opportunity, and are stewards of our community and the environment.

**Mission**

The primary mission of the Conservation Corps of Long Beach is to support young people in realizing their potential through work, service, conservation, and education.

**Position Summary**

At CCLB, our mission comes first. The Landscape Construction and Capital Projects Departments operate as a workforce training program, where Corpsmembers learn green infrastructure project implementation by working on real projects. This includes landscape installation, irrigation, hardscape, tree planting, stormwater improvements, and park and facility upgrades for public agencies and nonprofit partners. Every project has two goals: deliver quality work for our partners and prepare Corpsmembers for careers in construction and the green workforce.

Under the supervision of the Senior Project Manager, and in close coordination with the Director of Projects and Construction Training, the Construction Project Coordinator will learn and take on construction administration for these projects from preconstruction through closeout. This includes budgets, schedules, RFIs, submittals, change orders, billing, and project correspondence. The position also supports crew coordination and plays an active role in training and mentoring Corpsmembers on the job.

This position is split between the office and the field. Approximately 60% of the time is spent in the office on project administration, and 40% is spent on job sites meeting with clients and inspectors, monitoring progress, and supporting crews.

CCLB is committed to growing its staff the same way we grow our Corpsmembers. Candidates do not need to come in with construction administration experience. The selected candidate will receive on the job training and mentorship from the Senior Project Manager and the Director of Projects and Construction Training in budgets, RFIs, submittals, change orders, scheduling, and project closeout, along with support to earn certifications such as OSHA 30 and First Aid/CPR. We are looking for someone who is organized, eager to learn, and committed to our mission.

**Construction Administration**

* **RFIs:** Prepare, submit, and track RFIs, and coordinate timely responses with designers, clients, and field staff.
* **Submittals:** Prepare and track shop drawings, product data, and samples for compliance with plans and specifications.
* **Change orders:** Prepare change order requests with cost backup and track them through approval.
* **Billing:** Prepare schedules of values, monthly pay applications, and invoices, and track payments and retention.
* **Correspondence:** Write clear, professional emails, letters, and meeting minutes, and respond to project inquiries promptly.
* **Documents and logs:** Review plans, specifications, and contracts, and keep RFI, submittal, and change order logs current.
* **Permits and compliance:** Coordinate permits, inspections, and DigAlert, and track insurance, bonds, subcontractor paperwork, and prevailing wage reporting.
* **Closeout:** Manage punch lists, as built drawings, warranties, O&M manuals, final inspections, and lien releases.

**Budgets and Estimating**

* Build, monitor, and report on budgets across multiple projects.
* Assist with cost estimates, quantity takeoffs, proposals, and bid documents.
* Request and compare vendor and subcontractor quotes, and prepare purchase orders.
* Reconcile project costs and revenue monthly with Finance, and code invoices to the correct cost centers.

**Coordination**

* Prepare and update project schedules, and flag delays early.
* Lead or attend preconstruction meetings, progress meetings, and site walks, and prepare agendas and minutes.
* Visit job sites regularly to check progress, quality, and safety, and document conditions with daily reports and photos.
* Coordinate crews, materials, equipment, deliveries, and subcontractors.
* Serve as a point of contact for clients, cities, agencies, design professionals, and partners.

**Supervision**

* Prepare weekly crew schedules and maintain the department project schedule.
* Supervise assigned field supervisors and their Corpsmember crews, as directed by the Senior Project Manager.
* Review and approve timecards in Paycom, and track labor hours by project.
* Lead tailgate safety meetings and support compliance with Cal/OSHA and CCLB safety policies.
* Help train Corpsmembers in landscape installation, irrigation, hardscape, plan reading, and job site safety.
* Mentor Corpsmembers on the job, helping them build construction skills, strong work habits, and confidence, and guiding them toward careers in the trades.
* Take part in interviews and orientation for new Corpsmembers.
* Assist with staff evaluations, coaching, and corrective action, and counsel, motivate, and discipline Corpsmembers as needed.

**Reporting and Record-keeping**

* Keep project files organized on the CCLB OneDrive.
* Make sure field supervisors submit daily reports, timesheets, and photos on time.
* Track daily project metrics and complete monthly metrics reports.
* Prepare weekly, monthly, and final project reports, including budget to actual reports.
* Prepare reports and presentations for sponsors, the CCLB Board, and City Council as needed.
* Report equipment and vehicle ne

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position: Project Coordinator**

**Company:** Levelit Builders Inc.

**Location:** California (On-Site)

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Salary:** $70,000 - $80,000 annually *(final compensation will be determined based on experience & skills)*

**About Levelit Builders**

We are a fast-growing, dynamic construction contractor operating with the agility, speed, and innovation of a modern startup. Based in California, we specialize in high-quality commercial interior finishes, drywall, metal stud framing, and radiation shielding systems. We take pride in delivering exceptional projects through smart project management, close collaboration, and a relentless focus on execution.

**The Role**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented **Project Coordinator** to support Project Managers and Superintendents in organizing, tracking, and executing commercial construction projects. They act as the primary communication bridge between field crews, subcontractors, architects, engineers, and clients to ensure projects stay on schedule, within budget, and fully compliant with project plans. If you thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment where your impact is immediate, this is the role for you. Your scope of work will include but not limited to the following -

**Support to Project Managers & Superintendents:**

* Serve as the daily partner to Project Managers and Superintendents, bridging office operations with job-site needs.
* Track daily field progress, site logs, and superintendent notes to identify potential delays or scope issues early.
* Coordinate material deliveries, equipment rentals, crane schedules, and site logistics directly with field superintendents and trade vendors.

**Contract, RFI & Submittal Management:**

* Process and track RFIs, Submittals, Shop Drawings, and Product Data using commercial software (e.g., Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud).
* Expedite long-lead commercial items (structural steel, glazing systems, major HVAC units) to match the superintendent’s field schedule.

**Subcontractor Management & Compliance:**

* Assist Project Managers with assembling bid packages, evaluating trade scope proposals, and drafting subcontracts.
* Collect and verify subcontractor Certificates of Insurance (COI) with commercial liability limits, safety logs, and lien releases.
* Ensure all trade contractors are properly onboarded and aligned with site safety rules set by the superintendent.

**Cost Control & Billing Support:**

* Review subcontractor pay applications against actual work completed in the field with the superintendent.
* Maintain Proposed Change Order (PCO) logs, tracking cost impacts from initial field discovery to client approval.

**Permitting, Inspections & Closeout:**

* Coordinate municipal building permits, utility sign-offs, and third-party inspection schedules for the superintendent.
* Track quality control checklists, testing logs, and superintendent-generated punch lists.

**Qualifications**

**Experience:** Project coordination experience with a general or trade contractor preferably focused on commercial drywall, framing, or interior systems supporting field & office teams.

**Skills:**

* Experience with in project management software such as On-Screen Takeoff (OST) & Quick Bid.
* Excellent communications skills between client interactions, project stakeholders, and field employees.

**What we Offer**

* Competitive base salary.
* 401K retirement plan with company match.
* Paid Time Off.
* Opportunities for growth & development.

Pay: $70,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Summary:**

We are seeking a creative and proactive Social Media Coordinator to support the marketing and brand visibility of our Los Angeles-based commercial property portfolio. This role focuses on creating high-impact digital content that promotes office, retail and commercial properties, engages tenants and prospects, and reinforces our position in the commercial real estate market.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and implement a consistent and strategic social media calendar, aligning content with leasing activity, property events, and branding goals.
* Serve as a proactive content creator, producing compelling, on-brand visual and written content that highlights property features, tenant success stories, and market insights.
* Stay current with industry trends, platform algorithms, and social media best practices to ensure content remains engaging, relevant, and competitive.

* Act as a clear and consistent communicator, ensuring internal stakeholders, leasing teams, and property managers are kept up to date on campaign progress, content schedules, and performance insights.
* Monitor and manage daily social media activity across platforms (LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok), ensuring timely and professional engagement.
* Assist with social media advertising and boosted content in coordination with the marketing team.
* Track KPIs and prepare monthly reports on performance metrics including reach, engagement, follower growth, and campaign ROI.
* Collaborate with outside vendors (photographers, videographers, designers) to elevate content quality when needed.

**Qualifications:**

* 1–2 years of experience in social media management or digital marketing; experience in commercial real estate or B2B marketing is a strong plus.
* Proficiency with social platforms (LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok) and content planning tools (e.g., Buffer, Later, Hootsuite).
* Strong written and visual communication skills with an eye for detail and brand alignment.
* Ability to manage feedback, maintain professionalism, and foster a positive online brand presence.
* Self-starter with excellent time management, able to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Familiarity with commercial property marketing, leasing terminology, or property operations is preferred.

* Experience with paid social media campaigns (LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads Manager)
* Basic graphic design (Canva, Adobe Express) or video editing (CapCut, iMovie)
* Understanding of CRE data tools (CoStar, Yardi, VTS) or CRM software

jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

The Digital Marketing Center of Excellence (COE) Operations team supports Disney Entertainment Studios, Disney Entertainment Television, and Direct-to-Consumer teams. The team oversees business operations, YouTube operations, social platform operations, and influencer marketing operations, while centralizing tools, vendors, and systems across the broader Marketing COE. The team partners closely with Technology, IT, Anti-Piracy, Legal, Finance, and platform partners on product and feature rollouts, vendor management, and payments. It also serves as the primary point of contact for social media and YouTube best practices across the COE.

#### **Job Summary**

Reporting to the Manager, Digital Marketing Operations, the Digital Marketing Operations Coordinator supports the Disney Entertainment Digital Marketing COE Operations team. The role assists studio, television, brand, and title marketing teams with day-to-day operational needs, including social account acquisition and setup, brand safety checks, and access permissions for internal employees and approved vendors.

The coordinator supports The Walt Disney Company’s (TWDC) content management system (CMS) environment, ensuring accounts are managed in accordance with company guidelines and industry standards. The role also supports daily invoicing and payment requests, ensuring payments are coded to the appropriate line of business (LOB).

The ideal candidate is collaborative, results-driven, and detail-oriented, with a strong understanding of social, digital, and emerging platforms. They manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment while championing consistent operational best practices.

#### **Responsibilities**

* Support social platform operations across the broader network by acquiring and setting up social accounts and managing verification, access, and permissions.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external platform representatives to troubleshoot issues and coordinate escalations with Cybersecurity and Anti-Piracy stakeholders.
* Perform quarterly account login updates and resets across owned and operated social accounts in accordance with brand safety and cybersecurity best practices.
* Conduct internal audits of owned channels and networks, including quarterly audits of internal network channels, to streamline operational workflows.
* Process CMS permission requests across TWDC while enforcing security and access controls. Support third-party tool integrations and maintenance, including Sprinklr and Crisp, ensuring accounts are connected for reporting and moderation.
* Create and maintain marketing email distribution lists across the Digital Marketing COE.
* Support invoicing, payments, and vendors by managing invoice submissions and payee payment requests, ensuring accuracy, compliance with company guidelines, and correct business unit or LOB coding.
* Track invoice payments and quarterly spending by LOB and provide senior leadership with monthly and quarterly spending reports.
* Partner with content leads on invoice submissions, troubleshooting, vendor setup, and Contingent Workforce Management approvals.
* Monitor overall budget and content development spending against the approved annual allocation and flag issues or overages to Finance.
* Support new vendor onboarding and investigate payment delays and other payment issues.
* Coordinate the request pipeline with the Royalties Processing team and communicate resource needs and timelines to stakeholders.

#### **Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of professional or internship experience in marketing, operations, social media, or digital marketing.
* Experience working in customer relationship management (CRM) tools such as Salesforce, Airtable, and Zendesk.
* Strong knowledge of social media platforms, including YouTube, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and TikTok.
* Proficiency in using YouTube’s CMS.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to communicate and implement operational processes.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple ongoing projects.
* A collaborative, continuous-learning mindset, strong work ethic, and commitment to confidentiality and process improvement, with the ability to thrive amid change and quickly adapt to new technologies and processes. Required.
* Candidates must live within a reasonable commuting distance of our Glendale, CA office and work onsite four days per week.

**Required Education:**

* Pursues effective peer relationships within and across teams to obtain and share resources and information. Listens to, addresses, and seeks performance feedback; acts as an informal resource for less experienced team members. Actively seeks new relevant knowledge and skills based on strengths and weaknesses; reviews others work to help others learn. Adapts to change, challenges, and feedback with minimal guidance; demonstrates flexibility in work. Assesses and responds to the needs of others to support completion of work tasks.

Collaborates with others to recommend appropriate solutions for routine and non-routine issues; escalates complex issues; communicates progress and information. * Assist with billing documentation and verify information for accuracy.

* Build and maintain positive working relationships with customers and internal departments.

* Previous experience in customer service, clerical support, or administrative operations required.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook and Excel.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and meet deadlines.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to customer service.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.
* Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS) or transportation management systems (TMS) is a plus.
* Familiarity with shipping documents, container movements, and port-related operations is a plus.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities, communicates clearly, and understands the importance of providing reliable customer service.

* **Dependable:** Consistently follows through on tasks and commitments.
* **Detail-Oriented:** Maintains accuracy when handling orders, documentation, and customer information.

At FWT Logistics, we recognize that strong customer relationships and efficient operations are essential to our success.

If you are organized, motivated, and interested in building your career in the logistics industry, we encourage you to apply.

Social Media Manager

* Whimsocal Studios | Full-Time, Hybrid
* Department: Marketing
* Reports To: Director of Marketing
* Brands: JuJuBe, Bella Tunno, Studio Oh!, Orange Circle Studio, and Saturday Sundae

The Social Media Manager will own the development, execution, and optimization of organic social media strategies across Whimsocal Studios' portfolio of brands. This is a hands-on role requiring both strategic thinking and creative execution. The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller, an experienced content creator, and a data-driven marketer who understands social trends, platform algorithms, audience behavior, and the importance of maintaining distinct brand identities. Working closely with the Director of Marketing, Product, Design, Ecommerce, and Sales, this individual will translate marketing priorities and product launches into compelling social content and measurable channel growth.

**Social Media Strategy & Growth**

* Develop and execute organic social media strategies tailored to each brand's positioning, audience, and business objectives.
* Own social media content calendars across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Pinterest, and other relevant platforms.
* Build platform-specific content strategies that support brand awareness, audience growth, engagement, website traffic, and product discovery.
* Identify emerging trends, cultural moments, and content opportunities relevant to each brand.
* Develop creative approaches to product launches, seasonal campaigns, brand storytelling, and evergreen content.
* Collaborate with the Director of Marketing to establish channel priorities, growth objectives, and performance benchmarks.

**Content Creation**

* Conceptualize, create, and produce engaging, platform-native content, including Reels, TikToks, Stories, short-form video, and static posts.
* Capture and edit social-first content, including product demonstrations, behind-the-scenes footage, lifestyle content, and trend-driven videos.
* Write compelling, brand-appropriate captions, hooks, and calls to action.
* Develop content briefs and shot lists for social media content needs, coordinating with Creative and Marketing on production.
* Repurpose existing photography, video, and approved creator content into engaging social assets.
* Maintain consistent visual storytelling and distinct brand voices across the portfolio.
* Identify opportunities to improve content quality, storytelling, and production efficiency.

**Campaign Planning & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Translate integrated marketing calendars, product launches, and promotional priorities into actionable social media plans.
* Partner with Ecommerce to align social content with product availability, merchandising priorities, and customer behavior.
* Collaborate with Product & Design to ensure timely development and delivery of campaign assets.
* Work with the Influencer & Community Coordinator to incorporate approved influencer and user-generated content into social calendars.
* Coordinate with the Social Media Coordinator on publishing, scheduling, asset organization, and execution.
* Ensure social content follows internal review processes, brand guidelines, and applicable licensing approval requirements.

**Social Media Performance & Optimization**

* Own organic social media reporting, including reach, impressions, engagement, follower growth, content performance, and referral traffic.
* Establish and maintain performance benchmarks to evaluate channel growth over time.
* Analyze content performance to identify what resonates with each brand's audience.
* Recommend content adjustments and testing opportunities based on performance insights.
* Provide monthly social media recaps highlighting key takeaways, opportunities, and actionable recommendations.
* Monitor platform changes and evolving best practices to continuously improve social performance.

**Social Execution & Channel Management**

* Oversee day-to-day social media execution and ensure content is published accurately and on schedule.
* Maintain visibility into publishing calendars, creative assets, campaign deadlines, and approval statuses.
* Guide the part-time Social Media Coordinator on approved content execution and publishing priorities.
* Ensure timely coordination of social assets, captions, links, and campaign materials.
* Partner with the Influencer & Community Coordinator to surface community feedback, emerging conversations, and content opportunities.

**Qualifications**

* 3–5+ years of professional experience in social media management, content creation, or digital marketing, preferably within consumer products, lifestyle, retail, or ecommerce.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing organic social strategies that drive measurable audience growth and engagement.
* Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Pinterest, and evolving social media trends.
* Proven ability to create and edit engaging short-form video content independently.
* Experience with social scheduling, analytics, and reporting tools, preferably Sprout Social.
* Proficiency with content creation tools such as CapCut, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar platforms.
* Strong copywriting skills and the ability to adapt tone and storytelling across multiple brands.
* Experience supporting product launches, promotional campaigns, and integrated marketing initiatives.
* Ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Excellent project management, organization, and communication skills.
* Comfortable managing multiple brands, competing priorities, and fast-moving deadlines.
* Experience working with licensed consumer products and approval processes is a plus.

jobs.title: Traffic Coordinator
jobs.description:
**To thrive as a Traffic Coordinator**, you’ll play a key role in managing and optimizing corporate fleet operations and freight movements. This position ensures smooth transportation processes by coordinating shipments, maintaining accurate records, and supporting adherence to safety and regulatory standards. You will work closely with carriers, vendors, and logistics hubs to improve efficiency, resolve freight issues, and keep systems updated for accurate tracking and reporting.

**Here's what we're looking for:**

  

* Coordinate and handle all freight movements, including warehouse transfers, vendor pick-ups, and store-opening orders.
* Maintain carrier files, pricing information, and update transportation databases for accuracy.
* Prepare shipper summary reports and ensure timely communication with customers.
* Audit freight bills, confirm rates, and resolve discrepancies with carriers.
* Handle vehicle compliance with safety policies and government regulations, including insurance and registration documentation.
* Collaborate with regional distribution centers to develop guidelines for lane optimization.
* High school diploma or equivalent, such as a GED
* Strong experience in freight administration, logistics, and record-keeping preferred.
* Knowledge of freight tracking, scheduling, OSHA regulations, and transportation laws preferred.
* Proficiency in MS Office and ability to manage computerized records.
* Excellent interpersonal skills to plan carrier selection, driver assignments, and equipment needs.

**Here's what we offer you:**

  

* Traffic Coordinators start at $27.00/hr. Team members will receive a $0.50/hr increase at 6 months of employment and another $0.50hr increase at one year of employment.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Description:

**RxSight® is an ophthalmic medical technology corporation headquartered in Aliso Viejo, California that has commercialized the world’s first and only adjustable intraocular lens (IOL) that is customized after cataract surgery. The company’s mission is to revolutionize the premium cataract surgery experience by allowing surgeons to partner with their patients to achieve optimized results for every unique eye.**

**OVERVIEW:**

The Executive Assistant provides high-level administrative and operational support to the Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) and other designated senior leadership positions. This highly visible role coordinates executive priorities, calendars, communications, meetings, travel, and confidential business matters, with particular emphasis on supporting the commercial organization. The successful candidate is proactive, resourceful, highly organized, and exercises exceptional judgment, professionalism, and discretion while managing competing priorities in a fast-paced public company environment.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Executive & Administrative Support**

* Provide comprehensive administrative support to the Chief Commercial Officer and other designated senior leaders, as needed.
* Manage complex executive calendars, prioritize competing requests, coordinate meetings, and anticipate scheduling conflicts to maximize executive effectiveness.
* Draft, edit, proofread, and prepare executive correspondence, reports, presentations, meeting materials, and other business documents with exceptional accuracy and professionalism.
* Manage incoming inquiries and communications, exercising sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism while ensuring timely follow-up.
* Anticipate the needs of the Chief Commercial Officer and supported senior leaders and proactively resolve administrative and logistical issues.
* Coordinate commercial leadership activities, including leadership meeting logistics, calendars, agendas, presentations, meeting notes, and follow-up on action items.
* Build strong relationships with executives, employees, customers, commercial partners, and external business contacts while serving as a trusted representative of the supported leaders.
* Support commercial strategic initiatives, cross-functional projects, and senior leadership priorities while maintaining the highest level of confidentiality.
* Organize office operations, procedures, and executive administrative activities to ensure efficient workflow.

**Meeting & Event Coordination**

* Plan, schedule, and coordinate executive and commercial leadership meetings and onsite or virtual events, ensuring meeting materials, technology, catering, logistics, and follow-up activities are completed seamlessly.
* Coordinate commercial leadership meetings, cross-functional meetings, company events, executive off-sites, and leadership retreats as requested.
* Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, supporting documentation, and action item summaries.
* Coordinate company-sponsored meals and hospitality arrangements as requested.

**Travel & Expense Management**

* Coordinate complex domestic and international travel arrangements for the Chief Commercial Officer and other designated senior leaders, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, visas, and detailed itineraries.
* Prepare, review, and reconcile travel and expense reports using Concur or equivalent expense management systems.
* Anticipate travel changes and resolve travel-related issues with minimal disruption.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Handle highly confidential business, personnel, commercial, and corporate information with the highest level of integrity, professionalism, and discretion.
* Represent the Chief Commercial Officer and other supported senior leaders professionally in all internal and external interactions.
* Maintain organized executive records, commercial leadership materials, meeting documentation, and action-item tracking in accordance with company policies and document retention requirements.
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Requirements:

**REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**

* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Proficiency with video conferencing platforms (Microsoft Teams, Zoom).
* Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple assignments and consistently meet critical deadlines.
* Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to produce high-quality work with minimal supervision.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain strict confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive business, employee, and commercial matters.
* Strong understanding of executive-level business operations and the coordination needs of a commercial leadership organization.
* Executive presence with the ability to build trusted relationships with senior leaders, employees, customers, and external business partners.
* Ability to work collaboratively across all levels of the organization in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* None

**EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, and TRAINING:**

* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Minimum of 7–10 years of Executive Assistant experience supporting C-suite executives or other senior leaders, preferably including commercial leadership.
* Experience supporting multiple senior leaders and coordinating priorities across a complex organization; public company experience preferred.
* Experience supporting Commercial, Sales, Marketing, Business Development, or other cross-functional corporate organizations preferred.
* Demonstrated experience organizing executive and leadership meetings, preparing agendas and presentations, coordinating logistics, and tracking follow-up actions.
* Experience working in a public company environment and hand

jobs.title: Construction Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

Tesla is looking for a Construction Project Coordinator to support the construction of the new ground up Semi truck manufacturing facility that requires exceptional talent. Our environment is fast-paced and incredibly exciting. Required commitment is that you bring in your passion for advancing energy sustainability, your desire to work on difficult problems pushing the limits, your willingness to value team success beyond your own, and your unwavering positive attitude towards sustained hard work. This position is full time, onsite in Fremont, CA

As an Associate Construction Project Manager, you will work in a cross functional role coordinating construction activities between project managers and field superintendents, supporting material procurements, performing field quantity verifications, assisting in tracking projects’ cost and schedules performance and ensuring deliverable dates are met.

 **What You'll Do**

* Project Start-Up tasks including supporting the development and tracking of RFP’s, bid leveling and Purchase Order justifications for approval
* Perform daily walk downs of the job site to document performance against the schedule. Develop and submit RFI’s, as needed, based on feedback from field crews to resolve constructability issues as soon as possible
* Coordinate material requisitions to support field activities, including obtaining supplier quotes, analyze for best value, verify receipt, and coordinate delivery to field teams
* Meeting coordination and conference room reservations. Attend meetings for taking minutes and documenting required actions
* Coordinate with contractors to ensure RFI’s, submittals and other necessary documentation is submitted and processed in a timely manner
* Support Project Managers in the development of supporting Change Control documentation
* Facilitate onboarding and orientation of vendors and contractors

  
**What You'll Bring**

* 2-5 years of experience in a coordinator capacity preferably with an architecture, design or construction firm
* Degree in Electrical, Mechanical or Civil disciplines preferred, or equivalent experience
* Ability to effectively prioritize with strong time management skills in a fast-paced environment
* Superior verbal and written communication skills, highly organized with a strong attention to detail, high level of professionalism and strong sense of urgency
* Intermediate to advanced skills in MS Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
* Proficiency in Bluebeam, Aconex, PlanGrid, and MS Project preferred
* Proactive, motivated self-starter, ability to work with minimal guidance, flexibility and ability to -handle and manage change effectively and efficiently

#### **Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program
* Earned Wage Access: Real-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels)

  

#### **Expected Compensation**

$96,000 - $162,000/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits

Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

  
Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: Privacy Program Specialist, Consultant
jobs.description:
**Your Role**

The Privacy Office develops and oversees Blue Shield’s Privacy Program. The Privacy Program ensures that Blue Shield and its affiliated covered entities, including Blue Shield of California Promise Health Plan, are in compliance with state and federal privacy laws and regulations, including the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA), the Health Information Technology for Economic and Clinical Health Act of 2009 (HITECH), and California’s Confidentiality of Medical Information Act (CMIA). The Privacy Program Specialist, Consultant reports to the Privacy Office Manager or Director and plays an essential role in advancing and enforcing Blue Shield’s Privacy Program.

  

**Your Work**

In this role, you will:

* Support the Privacy Office’s oversight of Blue Shield's compliance with applicable state and federal privacy laws, including HIPAA and HITECH
* Lead assigned privacy inquiries that involve responding to individual rights requests and questions, privacy complaints, and requests for privacy guidance, as the primary focus of this role
* Manage all aspects of assigned cases, including regulatory analysis, prompt follow-up, and timely and accurate documentation of case files. Identify matters requiring escalation and, when appropriate, direct business units in conducting root-cause analysis, and implementing mitigation and remediation efforts
* Assist, evaluate, and determine appropriateness of ad hoc requests from internal clients to disclose protected health information (PHI) to third parties, including employer-sponsored health plans, and/or to allow third parties access to, or use of, Blue Shield PHI
* Consult with internal clients as a subject matter expert, providing privacy guidance about proposed projects and enterprise-wide initiatives that involve the access, use, or disclosure of Blue Shield PHI
* Develop and assist with the implementation of workforce privacy trainings, privacy policies, desk level procedures, resource guides, job aids, and other educational tools
* Audit and monitor compliance with the Privacy Program, develop and implement corrective action plans (CAPs) on behalf of the Privacy Office, advise on CAPs issued by other business units that include privacy-related components, and conduct Privacy Impact Assessments and Data Protection Impact Assessments
* When internal business needs arise, assist with negotiating Business Associate Agreements, lead privacy investigations, and act as a liaison with regulatory enforcement agencies to address technical assistance letters, investigation compliance reviews, audits, and other related reviews
* Perform other duties as assigned

  

**Your Knowledge and Experience**

* Requires a bachelor’s degree or High School Diploma/GED and 4 years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree
* Requires at least 7 years of prior relevant experience in healthcare privacy, healthcare compliance, health information management functions related to fulfilling individual rights requests, or another related field
* Requires a deep working knowledge and application of California state and federal privacy laws, including HIPAA/HITECH, CMIA, minor consent laws, and privacy-related consumer protections laws, such as the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA). Additionally, a solid understanding of Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) and Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) privacy requirements
* Preferred: Privacy compliance health plan experience that includes familiarity with Privacy Impact Assessments; health information management; auditing and monitoring; investigating, managing, and reporting privacy incidents; corporate compliance training
Preferred: CIPP/US Certification or HCCA CHPC Certification  

**Hybrid**

This role requires employees to be in-office based on our hybrid workplace model, balancing purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility. For most teams, this means coming into the office two days each week.

Employees living more than 50 miles from an office location will work with their manager to determine in-office time based on business need.

As of January 2025, Blue Shield of California became a subsidiary of Ascendiun. Ascendiun is a nonprofit corporate entity that is the parent to a family of organizations including Blue Shield of California and its subsidiary, Blue Shield of California Promise Health Plan; Altais, a clinical services company; and Stellarus, a company designed to scale healthcare solutions. Together, these organizations are referred to as the Ascendiun Family of Companies.

At Blue Shield of California, our mission is to create a healthcare system worthy of our family and friends and sustainably affordable. We are transforming health care in a way that genuinely serves our nonprofit mission by lowering costs, improving quality, and enhancing the member and physician experience.

To achieve our mission, we foster an environment where all employees can thrive and contribute fully to address the needs of the various communities we serve. We are committed to creating and maintaining a supportive workplace that upholds our values and advances our goals.

Blue Shield is a U.S. News Best Company to work for, a Deloitte U.S. Best Managed Company and a Top 100 Inspiring Workplace. We were recognized by Fair360 as a Top Regional Company, and one of the 50 most community-minded companies in the United States by Points of Light. Here at Blue Shield, we strive to make a positive change across our industry and communities – join us!

Working closely with Program Managers, Construction Directors, project teams, and cross-functional partners, you will help coordinate recurring project and program activities, maintain accurate reporting and documentation, and support standardized processes that strengthen project oversight and operational efficiency across a large and evolving construction portfolio.

In this role, you will support a variety of construction-related business and operational functions, including capital project reporting, financial review coordination, resource workload planning and tracking, dashboard maintenance, and program governance activities. Responsibilities include coordinating capital financial review meetings and preparing supporting materials, consolidating project budget and schedule information, maintaining Resource Load Plans (RLPs) and planned-versus-actual hours reporting, tracking project milestones and outstanding action items, and supporting the development and maintenance of project and portfolio dashboards. You will also coordinate stakeholder communications, maintain program documentation, and help ensure critical reporting activities and deliverables remain on schedule.

jobs.title: Medical Student Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

Reporting to the Associate Administrative Director, MedEd, the Medical Student Clerkship Coordinator position will provide overall high-level support to Medical Student Education Program primarily by coordinating the Traditional Clerkship, including Clinical Skills Sessions and Didactics series for the traditional clerkship, support of the PISCES Longitudinal Clerkship Clinical Skills Session and site scheduling plus PISCES School didactics. Specific duties include primary interface with all clerkship sites, site administration of the Mission Bay/Mt. Zion clerkship site, proctoring exams 7 times a year; preparing student orientation materials and presentations; assistance with coordinating education program research and student research opportunities alongside the Medical Education Director; primary initiator of clerkship student assessment and grading needs, plus general course coordination. This position also is the point person in coordinating the Volunteer Clinical Professor (VCP) program. The major functions are communicating as the department representative with the volunteer professor and HR representative, managing the volunteer clinical faculty (VCP) database, and producing annual evaluation reports for academic and non-VCP instructors. This position will also interface with ENACT (UCSF-Stanford Endometriosis Center for Discovery, Innovation, Training and Community Engagement) on specifics related to Endometriosis research. This role also serves as backup for the F1 and Undergraduate Research Internship (URI) Administrator on various tasks and provides support to the Associate Administrative Director and Faculty Program Directors. There may be other duties as needed.

**DEPARTMENT INFO:**

The Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology and Reproductive Sciences (Ob, Gyn & RS) is a major academic Department in the School of Medicine, engaged in clinical, research and training activities at the Parnassus, Mt. Zion and San Francisco General Hospital campuses, the Betty Irene Moore Women’s Hospital at Mission Bay, as well as satellite locations throughout the Bay Area, with an annual operating budget of $146 million. The Department has 111 full-time faculty, 117 other academic appointees, 13 post-doctoral fellows, 20 clinical fellows, 32 residents, 138 voluntary clinical faculty and 270 staff. The mission of the UCSF Department of Ob, Gyn & Reproductive Sciences is to improve the lives and health of all women through excellence, innovation and leadership in Patient Care, Scientific Discovery, Education, Advocacy, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. “Leading the way in women’s health.”

The mission of the Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology & Reproductive Sciences is to improve the lives and health of all women through excellence, innovation and leadership in patient care, scientific discovery, education, advocacy, and diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to providing quality health care services; educating health care providers and investigators; and conducting research to advance knowledge in our field.

* Investigative, data analysis, and reporting skills. Ability to generate computer reports, checking for errors, correcting and submitting accurate reports. Skills include entering, maintaining, extracting, and analyzing data in electronic systems.
* Experience with MS Office Suite applications (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook) and Zoom and other virtual meeting platforms.
* Ability to work independently and with others in a fast paced, deadline driven environment
* Establish and maintain effective interpersonal relationships with all levels of staff and learners within the department.
* Ability to use sound judgment in responding to issues and concerns.
Ability to use discretion and maintain confidentiality.

* Basic knowledge of relevant policies and regulatory requirements for Medical Education. Basic knowledge of health professions education industry.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We're redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall's AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We've built a product customers love and a business that's scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.

At Aircall, you'll join a company in motion. We're ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

  

**How we work at Aircall**: We're customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you'll feel at home here.

As a Confirmed Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.

By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.

This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You'll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.

Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.

**This is a hybrid role based in New York and San Francisco.**

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Own NRR: Manage the full post-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.
* Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.
* Target Strategically: Prioritize high-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long-term growth plans.
* Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
* Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
* Sell Competitively: Position Aircall's value head-to-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer's unique business needs.
* Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
* Manage Pipeline & Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data-driven NRR forecasting.
* Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
* Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall's product roadmap and go-to-market strategies.
* Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.

  

### **Qualifications:**

* Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets.
* Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
* Customer-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.
* Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis.
* Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively.
* Analytical, detail-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene.
* Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long-term value through partnership.
* Excited by innovation and transformation — particularly the opportunity to represent a next-generation AI-powered communications platform.

jobs.description:
**Overview**

DDN is seeking a **Technical Account Manager (TAM)** to work directly with strategic enterprise and AI/ML customers, deploying, integrating, and optimizing DDN systems in production environments.  
As an TAM, you will serve as the hands-on technical lead responsible for ensuring the success, reliability, and performance of large-scale, globally distributed HPC and AI infrastructure. You’ll act as the bridge between DDN Engineering and customer Site Reliability/Operations teams, translating complex requirements into tested, automated, and maintainable solutions. You will also collaborate with sales and sales engineering teams to develop and optimize offerings to ensure customer success.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Deploy, configure, and optimize DDN storage and data management systems in customer environments.
* Partner with customer Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Operations teams to ensure production performance, availability, and scalability.
* Partner with DDN Sales and Sales Engineering teams to deliver solutions that add value to our customer environments
* Automate system monitoring, deployment, and configuration tasks using scripts and DevOps tooling.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across compute, storage, and networking layers.
* Develop and maintain deployment documentation, procedures, and best practices.
* Work with DDN Engineering and Product Management to translate field requirements into product enhancements (RFEs).
* Act as the on-site technical focal point during deployments, upgrades, and critical incidents.
* Lead technical meetings and operational reviews with customer and DDN stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement through feedback loops with Product, Support, and Engineering teams.
* Ensure alignment between deployed configurations and customer strategic roadmaps for HPC, AI, and ML workloads.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 8+ years of hands-on technical experience in systems engineering, deployment, or operations.
* Strong Linux administration background.
* Proven experience deploying and managing large-scale HPC, AI, or ML infrastructure.
* Deep knowledge of parallel file systems (Exascaler, Lustre, or GPFS).
* Experience configuring and troubleshooting InfiniBand and high-performance Ethernet networks.
* Proficiency with DevOps tools and scripting (Python, Bash, Ansible, etc.) for automation and monitoring.
* Familiarity with containers, orchestration (Kubernetes, Slurm), and hybrid/cloud environments.
* Experience developing and maintaining technical documentation and operational runbooks.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to interface directly with customer, engineering and executive teams.
* Comfortable working independently in globally distributed environments.
* Willingness to travel as required (up to 25%).
* Ability to lift up to 75 pounds when supporting hardware installations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AI/ML workflows, GPU-accelerated computing, or large-scale data pipelines.
* Familiarity with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
* Understanding of CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code methodologies.
* Project management or DevOps certification (e.g., PMP, CKA, AWS Solutions Architect) is a plus.

Compensation Range: $128K - $154K

jobs.title: Sales development representative
jobs.description:
Location

San Francisco

Type

Full-time

Department

Sales

Compensation

$70,000 - $100,000

  

**About Watershed**
-------------------

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

**The role**
------------

We’re looking for ambitious sales development hires to bring Watershed to more companies. We’re at an inflection point: every large company is launching a climate program as pressure for action builds every day. You’ll do whatever it takes to get those companies engaged on climate and excited about working with Watershed. As an early member of our go-to-market organization, you’ll help build the sales playbook, shape Watershed’s product, help us build a stellar team, and accelerate pipeline across North America.

This hire must be in our HQ in San Francisco.

**You will:**

* Open doors. Take a data-driven approach to prospecting that builds a pipeline across key customer segments, while building connections and establishing Watershed’s brand in markets we will be entering soon.
* Inspire action. Persuade prospects of the urgency of climate action and help them understand how Watershed can help them build a high-impact program, fast.
* Communicate like an expert. Companies will feel delighted and informed by your interactions, looking to you for both climate and Watershed product expertise.
* Take extreme ownership. Identify and actively address inefficiencies, : we need to leverage our tools for prospecting at speed
* Become an expert in climate, and educate companies on how they should navigate the world of carbon reduction targets, clean energy, carbon removal, and decarbonizing their supply chain.

**You might be a fit if:**

* You have 1-3 years of experience in sales or sales development and a consistent record of over-achieving your goals.
* You take extreme ownership of our customers’ first impressions of Watershed. Customers you’ve worked with in the past should rave about working with you.
* You’re flexible, adaptive, and resilient with a history of leaving systems, processes, and content better than you found them.
* You have a great attitude, a love of close team collaboration, and a desire to move and grow quickly in a fast-paced startup environment.

**Role Location**: This role will be based in our San Francisco HQ with the expectation of being in office 4x/week.

**Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)**

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

**What’s the interview process like?**

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

**What if I need accommodations for my interview?**

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

jobs.title: Inventory & Client Services Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Borg Trucking, Inc. is a family-owned business specializing in white-glove receiving, storage, delivery, and installation services for interior designers, furniture showrooms, and residential design projects throughout the San Francisco Bay Area.

We work with designers and their vendors to coordinate the logistics behind furnishing homes and other spaces, from receiving and inspecting individual pieces to storing, tracking, and delivering entire projects.

We're a small, hardworking team operating out of multiple warehouse facilities in South San Francisco. Our work is detail-driven, fast-paced, and constantly changing. We take pride in providing reliable, personalized service and maintaining strong relationships with our clients.

**About the Position**

We're seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive **Inventory & Client Services Coordinator** to help manage daily inventory operations and client communication.

This position serves as an important connection between our office, warehouse and clients. You'll be responsible for ensuring merchandise is accurately documented, inventory records are current and client requests are handled promptly,

We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, follows through on details, communicates effectively, and can manage competing priorities without constant supervision.

This is primarily an office-based position, but it requires regular interaction with our warehouse team and occasional hands-on involvement in warehouse operations.

Key Responsibilities

**Inventory Management & Receiving**

* Process and accurately enter incoming furniture, lighting, rugs, artwork, accessories, and other merchandise into our inventory management system.
* Review packing slips, purchase orders, bills of lading, and receiving documentation to verify shipment details.
* Match merchandise to the correct client, project, vendor, and item description.
* Review inspection photographs and condition reports for completeness and accuracy.
* Identify and document damages, shortages, incorrect merchandise, and discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate inventory records, including item descriptions, quantities, dimensions, condition notes, and warehouse locations.
* Track merchandise across multiple warehouses and storage areas.
* Work with warehouse staff to resolve missing information, unidentified merchandise, and receiving discrepancies.
* Monitor outstanding receiving tasks and ensure incoming inventory is processed in a timely manner.

**Client Services & Communication**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for interior designers and clients regarding inventory and warehouse requests.
* Respond promptly and professionally to client emails, requests, and questions.
* Send receiving confirmations, inspection reports, damage notifications, and inventory updates.
* Research and resolve inquiries regarding missing merchandise, status and discrepancies,
* Communicate with vendors and clients regarding damaged merchandise, returns, and replacement items.
* Maintain organized client correspondence and project records.
* Proactively follow up on outstanding issues to ensure they are resolved.

**Inventory Preparation, Work Orders & Warehouse Coordination**

* Prepare accurate, up-to-date inventory lists for upcoming deliveries, installations, and client pickups.
* Verify that requested merchandise has been received, properly documented, and is available for delivery or pickup.
* Work closely with warehouse staff to identify, locate, and resolve any inventory discrepancies or missing items.
* Prepare and maintain work orders, labor records, and supporting documentation for warehouse services and completed jobs.
* Coordinate client and vendor will-call requests, including preparing pickup lists and working with warehouse staff to ensure merchandise is ready for collection.
* Communicate with clients and vendors regarding merchandise repairs, replacements, returns, and other services to be performed at our warehouse.
* Coordinate with warehouse personnel and outside vendors to facilitate on-site repairs, inspections, and service appointments.
* Track outstanding repairs, returns, and inventory-related issues, following through to ensure they are completed and properly documented.
* Communicate relevant inventory updates, special handling instructions, and project details to the appropriate office and warehouse personnel.
* Review completed work orders and labor records to ensure all services performed are accurately documented for billing purposes.

**Receiving Charges, Storage & Billing Support**

* Review incoming merchandise and assign receiving charges based on established company pricing guidelines.
* Learn and apply our pricing practices for different types of furniture, merchandise, and handling requirements.
* Enter and maintain storage charges and related inventory billing records.
* Identify items requiring special handling, additional labor, or charges outside standard pricing guidelines.
* Verify that receiving, storage, and additional service charges are accurately documented.
* Communicate unusual charges, discrepancies, or pricing questions to management for review.
* Maintain organized supporting records to assist with accurate client invoicing.

*Training will be provided on our pricing structure and billing procedures. These responsibilities will be introduced progressively as familiarity with our operations develops.*

**Office & Operational Support**

* Maintain organized digital records, spreadsheets, client files, and warehouse documentation.
* Collaborate with office and warehouse staff to keep daily operations efficient and organized.
* Assist with tracking outstanding tasks, project updates, returns, and unresolved inventory issues.
* Help reinforce consistent procedures for receiving, inspections, inventory management, and documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve internal processes, organization, and workf

jobs.description:
Overview:

The Salvation Army is a faith-based organization and the largest non-profit provider of social services in the United States. The Salvation Army Brooklyn Brownsville Corps provides church services, food pantry, day care, and after school programming.

Under the direct supervision of the Middle School Program Director and the Corps Officers, the Program Specialist will run daily activities in the middle school-aged programming including but not limited to: homework help, serving meals and snacks, sports, music and arts, arts and crafts, creative arts, off-site field trips, and general day to day supervision of the children.

In addition, the Program Specialist will perform administrative duties, including but not limited to: record keeping, statistics, enrollment paperwork, food service documentation, grant funding paperwork, and other responsibilities as assigned.

The Program Specialist will be required to provide support to the Program Director. The Program Specialist should be experienced and qualified to assume greater leadership responsibility, in absence of the Program Director, when necessary.

During the school year, September-June, the position will be Monday through Friday from 2-6pm. For the seven weeks of summer break, the position will transition to a full day to accommodate summer day camp, for a total of 35 hours per week.

This position is in-person with required regional travel for field trips with children.

Responsibilities:

* Involvement in the total program with willingness to help in all areas as needed, including the classroom, dining room, outdoor/indoor activities, daily assembly.
* Promote observance of the moral and ethical code affecting children and staff.
* Completing Orientation Sessions and attending all parent meetings.
* Attend and contribute to Program Leadership Meetings.
* Help plan and conduct General Staff Meetings.
* Sharing with the Program Director and/or Corps Officers all matters of mutual concern relating to the total welfare of the Middle School Program.
* Complete a Debrief at the end of the school year & summer camp session to include areas of concern for the following program year.
* Assist with Corps programming as directed by Program Director and Corps Officers.
* Assist and support other activities as needed or instructed by the Corps Officers, such Seasonal Programs (Back- to-school supply drive, toy drive, coat drive, etc.) as required.
* Assists Program Director in advancing the mission of The Salvation Army by identifying children and families in need of additional services and connecting them to the Corps Officers.
* Serve as a positive role model.
* Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

* High School Diploma or equivalent; Associates Degree preferred.
* At least 3 Years of Experience in Youth or Camp Programming and the ability to teach and enthuse others preferred.
* *Willingness and comfortability leading students and families in devotions from the Bible preferred, but not required.*
* High energy, enthusiasm and a love of working with children.
* Strong writing and verbal communication skills are required.
* Professional demeanor and strong interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Attention to detail and follow through.
* Critical thinking and decision-making skills, displaying good judgement and ability to complete work independently.
* Collaborative attitude and ability to work with others in a team environment.
* Ability to communicate and work with groups of various ages and skill levels and provide necessary instruction to program participants and/or staff.
* Comfort working with children with behavioral challenges, and learning differences, etc
* Leadership experience with peers **and** experience in leadership of organized/specialized programming
* Current CPR & First Aid Certifications, or willingness to become certified.
* Physical ability to respond appropriately and quickly to situations requiring first aid.
* Available to work part-time hours on School Days and full-time hours on Non-School Days (School Holidays & Summer)

The Hazelden Betty Ford Foundation team is passionate about providing hope and ultimately healing. As a living, growing and evolving institution, the Hazelden Betty Ford Foundation is – at our core- a people-powered organization. Hazelden Betty Ford Foundation is comprised of 1600+ employees, seventeen treatment sites and produces $190 million dollars in annual revenue. Researchers at Johns Hopkins University conduct clinical trials and clinical studies to discover new ways to prevent and treat diseases and other health problems. We are seeking a ***Clinical Research Coordinator*** who will administratively coordinate clinical protocol implementation, typically for a single study. Will ensure efficient logistical implementation of the study activities and provide administrative support for research-related regulatory issues.

  
  

The Center for Latino Adolescent and Family Health (CLAFH) at the Johns Hopkins School of Nursing seeks a Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) to serve as a Clinical Research Coordinator, overseeing the daily implementation of community-based behavioral health and prevention programs serving adolescents, young adults, and families in the South Bronx. This position requires an active New York State LPN license and combines field-based program leadership, staff supervision, and clinical responsibilities within the scope of LPN licensure.

  
  

**Specific Duties & Responsibilities**

* Coordinate all activities of a clinical research study to ensure adherence to protocol and validity of findings.
* Participate in clinical study start-up meetings.
* Assist research nurses, study coordinators, principal investigators, and other study personnel in executing protocol-related activities.
* Explain the study background and rationale for the research to potential and current participants
* Contribute to the development of recruitment strategies for participants for assigned study.
* Implement a variety of techniques for recruitment as appropriate, e.g., print and web-based advertisements, contact referring physicians, participate in community events, etc.
* Independently conduct the consenting process or ensure consent is obtained on appropriate participants.
* Schedule participants for required activities and provide any special instructions prior to upcoming tests/exams.
* Serve as liaison to study participants.
* Assist with setup of the data collection system and enter and organize data.
* Assist in coordinating study meetings.
* Participate in study meetings and provide updates on protocol implementation status and make recommendations on operational issues.
* Assist with the preparation of submissions to the Institutional Review Board (IRB)
* Liaison with IRB on administrative matters and facilitate communications with the PI.
* Conduct literature searches to provide background information.
* Obtain and maintain excellent operating knowledge of assigned clinical protocol, clinical equipment, and clinical computer systems.
* Oversee budget expenditures for study operations.
* Other duties as assigned.
  

  

*In addition to the duties described above*

* Oversee daily field operations of community-based health and prevention programs, including home visits, community outreach, health screenings, prevention education, and referral and linkage to services.
* Coordinate and supervise field-based research and program staff, including community health workers and family coaches, and manage staff schedules, assignments, training, and program implementation activities.
* Perform clinical duties within the scope of LPN licensure, including health screenings, patient education, clinical documentation, and nursing services under appropriate clinical supervision.
* Oversee participant recruitment, enrollment, retention, and follow-up, ensuring fidelity to evidence-based intervention protocols and compliance with program requirements.
* Support nurse-led care coordination and collaboration with healthcare providers, community partners, and social service organizations to address participants' health and social needs.
* Current, active, and unrestricted Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) license in New York State. LPN licensure is a mandatory requirement for this position.
* Graduate of an accredited practical nursing program, with strong organizational, communication, and program coordination skills.
  

  

**On-call or Non-standard Work Hour Requirements**

* Full-time, in-person, primarily field-based position in the South Bronx, including participant homes and community partner locations. Occasional evening or weekend hours may be required to support community outreach, home visits, and program activities.
  

  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
  

* Bachelor's Degree in a related field.
* Additional education may substitute for required experience and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond a high school diploma/graduation equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.
  

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

jobs.description:
**About Us**

Wolf & Badger is on a mission to make retail fair. Supporting our community of independent designers from more than 70 countries, we connect customers with fashion, design, home and beauty from brands vetted against our sustainability guarantees, through our online marketplace and flagship stores in London, New York City and Los Angeles. We are a scale-up business based in the UK and US and a Certified B Corporation, with social and environmental purpose at the core of everything we do. We were the first UK online marketplace to become a certified B Corp, have been recognized by the Financial Times as one of Europe's Long-Term Growth Champions, and were one of the first marketplaces globally to take orders placed by AI shopping agents.

**The Role**

As our North American brand community grows, we are looking for a Brand Success Executive to join our New York team. Reporting to our Senior Brand Acquisition & Partnerships Manager, who leads our New York brands team, you will look after your own portfolio of US and Canada brands, from the day they join to the day they become one of our biggest success stories.

This is a relationship role with real commercial upside. The brands on Wolf & Badger are independent businesses, often run by their founders, and the best thing we can do for them is understand what they are trying to build. You will get to know your brands one-to-one, on calls, over coffee, at their studios and in our store, learn their goals, and help them grow: through their storefront and products, our marketing, sponsored listings and other retail media, and space in our stores through our store membership plans. As your brands grow, you share in that success through uncapped commission.

We use AI to take the repetitive work off your plate, so your time goes on what people do best: building relationships and exercising good judgment. We are looking for someone with high agency, who will look at how this role works, spot what can be streamlined, and make it happen, so there is more room to add value for brands. You will have Claude and AI-powered workflows from day one, and the freedom to build more.
