jobs.title: Operations Associate
jobs.description:
**ABOUT MINERVA**
-----------------

Minerva builds AI for marketing leaders. We work together with marketers to automate and accelerate their workflows with AI agents. Our agents augment the end-to-end workflow of the marketer by automating analysis, campaign planning, activation, measurement and reporting.

Customers like the NBA, Ramp, Wander, Hard Rock Stadium Group and Luxury Presence use Minerva to develop a better understanding of their customers and introduce AI specifically built to understand the customer into their commercial organizations. Our campaigns outperform other tools because we built the entire stack: from identity to enrichment to data integration as well as agents to action and report on the analysis.

We've raised $20M from The General Partnership, 8VC, Lingotto, NBA Investments, Topology Ventures, Future Positive, Background Capital and many others. Our team brings together operators and investors from Citadel, Dentsu, Bridgewater, Meta Superintelligence, Growthloop, Amazon and Lazard, alongside engineers and researchers from Berkeley, MIT, Stanford and Cambridge.

**THE ROLE**
------------

We're growing fast across New York and several countries, and every new person, vendor and candidate runs through operations. You keep that machine running and make it run better every month.

This is a generalist seat on a small operations team. You'll run the processes that touch everyone at Minerva: access and equipment, vendors and contracts, and the written procedures behind all of it. You'll also run the logistics for new-hire onboarding and interview scheduling, with our Head of Ecosystem, who owns the new-hire experience and our recruiting process. You'll work next to an engineer whose job is to automate this work, so part of your job is showing them what to automate next.

You report to our COO.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* **Keep access and devices in order.** Who has which tool, and who doesn't anymore, tracked well enough to hand to an auditor.
* **Run onboarding and offboarding logistics.** Accounts, equipment and background checks for hires in New York and abroad, so every first day starts ready.
* **Keep interviews moving.** Schedule loops and chase feedback, so no candidate waits on us.
* **Manage vendors and renewals.** Track contracts and renewal dates, run the intake for new tools, and chase what's overdue.
* **Write the playbook.** Every recurring process gets a documented, current procedure someone else could follow.
* **Find the next thing to automate.** You'll know which steps waste the most time, because you're the one doing them.

**WHAT YOU HAVE**
-----------------

* 1–3 years in operations, people operations, recruiting coordination, office or business operations, ideally at a startup or another fast, scrappy team.
* You finish things. Nothing you own falls through.
* You're organized enough that a process you run is easy to audit and easy to hand off.
* You write clearly and keep people informed without being asked.
* You use AI tools in your own work every day and you're curious about doing more with them.
* Discretion with personal and candidate information.
* You're in New York City or willing to relocate.

**YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU ARE…**
----------------------------------

* A recruiting coordinator who wants a bigger operations seat.
* An operations or office lead at a small company who did a bit of everything.
* An analyst or consultant who'd rather run things than recommend them.
* Or you don't fit any of these neatly, but you've made a messy process run well. Apply.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**
---------------------------

* **First 90 days:** every new hire's first day is set up before they arrive, every interview loop has its feedback in on time, and the access list is current.
* **First 6 months:** the recurring processes you run are all written down, and at least three of them have been automated with the engineer, on your recommendation.

**COMPENSATION**
----------------

$95,000–$121,000 base salary, depending on experience. Equity. Medical, dental and vision.

**HOW TO APPLY**
----------------

Skip the cover letter. Tell us about a messy, recurring process you took over and made run better: what was broken, what you changed and what it looked like a month later. A few paragraphs.

**WHERE WE WORK**
-----------------

We work in person from our office at 300 Kent Avenue in Williamsburg, Brooklyn.

**BENEFITS**
------------

Every full-time role includes equity; medical, dental and vision coverage; unlimited PTO; a monthly fitness stipend; and an annual company offsite. We'd rather pay people well than buy perks nobody uses.

**PAY TRANSPARENCY**
--------------------

The salary range in this posting is our good-faith range for the role in New York City at the time of posting. Where an offer lands depends on the level and experience we see in the interview process.

**APPLYING**
------------

Apply on this page. We don't take applications by email, and we don't accept unsolicited submissions from recruiting agencies. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, write to hiring@minerva.io.

**WORK AUTHORIZATION**
----------------------

You'll need to be authorized to work in the United States. We consider visa sponsorship case by case, so tell us on the application if you'll need it.

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY**
---------------------

Minerva is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, citizenship status, age, disability, marital status, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, New York State or New York City law.

jobs.title: Technical Operations Associate, Site Services
jobs.description:
The Technical Operations Associate supports day-to-day service coordination, reporting, documentation, scheduling, asset management, and technology operations. This role ensures operational tasks are completed accurately and on time while providing responsive service to internal stakeholders and business users.

Working closely with technology teams and support personnel, the associate coordinates service requests, monitors device compliance, maintains accurate records, and follows tasks through completion. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing recurring responsibilities and changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Review, manage, and prioritize incidents, service requests, projects, and operational tasks within ServiceNow.
* Monitor assigned queues, aging tickets, pending customer responses, and overdue updates to support timely resolution within established service levels.
* Prepare daily operational reports and end-of-day summaries covering completed work, outstanding items, project updates, priorities, escalations, risks, and blockers.
* Coordinate schedules, recurring meetings, reminders, maintenance windows, and follow-up activities.
* Monitor endpoint compliance, device health, and update status using Microsoft Intune and related management platforms.
* Maintain accurate ticket notes, status updates, troubleshooting records, and resolution documentation.
* Create and update operational procedures, knowledge articles, service documentation, and SharePoint content.
* Coordinate workstation deployments, equipment provisioning, hardware replacements, technology refreshes, and device lifecycle activities.
* Maintain inventory and asset records, track equipment, and support audit reviews.
* Coordinate operating system updates, software deployments, device maintenance, and scheduled support activities.
* Create and maintain ServiceNow tickets for recurring work, maintenance activities, and operational initiatives.
* Partner with internal teams to ensure work is appropriately assigned, tracked, and completed.
* Communicate service status, scheduling changes, and operational updates to stakeholders.
* Support projects, ad hoc requests, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive business information.
* Perform additional duties as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Experience using ServiceNow or a similar service management platform to track incidents, requests, projects, and operational workflows.

* Strong organizational and time-management skills, including managing multiple priorities, recurring tasks, and deadlines.
* Experience coordinating schedules, meetings, maintenance activities, and operational follow-up.
* Ability to prepare accurate reports, dashboards, status updates, and operational records.
* Strong documentation skills, including maintaining knowledge articles, procedures, and SharePoint content.
* Experience supporting inventory management, asset tracking, equipment lifecycle activities, and technology refreshes.
* Ability to identify service issues, operational risks, and process gaps and escalate concerns appropriately.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Strong problem-solving, critical-thinking, and follow-through skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
* Customer-focused approach with attention to accuracy, professionalism, and confidentiality.
* Adaptability to changing priorities and business requirements.

**Attributes That Drive Success**

* Self-motivated, organized, and detail-oriented.
* Proactive communication and consistent follow-through.
* Ownership of assigned tasks through completion.
* Ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Salary: $50,000 - $70,000

jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

* **Reports to:** Manager, Client Success Delivery
* **Location**: New York City office - hybrid

**The role**  
  
Spektrix has an exciting opportunity for Client Support Specialists to join our team!  
  
As one of our Client Success Specialists (CSS), you'll provide accurate and timely support and consistent relationship management to Spektrix clients as a member of a Client Success Delivery Team. You'll act as the named relationship owner for an assigned group of clients, while also contributing to the shared reactive support the team provides across its full client cohort. Ultimately, the success of this role is achieved through the delivery of services that lead to successful outcomes for all Spektrix clients within the delivery team’s portfolio.  
  
If you thrive on building meaningful connections, solving puzzles on the fly, and helping arts and cultural organizations succeed, we’d love for you to join us!

### **What You'll Do**

  

* **Multi-Channel Resolution & On-Call Coverage:** Resolve inbound client inquiries across phone, email, and video call using internal documentation and established processes, and participate in the support schedule, including rotating on-call coverage outside business hours.

* **Cross-Functional Alignment & Documentation:** Maintain detailed records of client interactions in internal systems while collaborating across Client Success, Product, Operations, Solutions, and Enablement to resolve complex issues and share actionable feedback.
* **Technical Escalation & Continuous Improvement:** Escalate complex technical issues falling outside standard procedures, while actively identifying opportunities to optimize internal processes and submitting recommendations to the CS Team Manager.
* **Professional Standards:** Consistently display professionalism and reliability in all client and team interactions to build lasting trust.

  

### **What You Bring**

  

* 1+ years of experience in a client- or customer-facing role, such as support, customer success, or account management, or in box office, ticketing, or patron services within an arts or culture organization.

* Ability to build effective working relationships with client stakeholders across a range of roles and levels of seniority.
* Ability to manage a wide range of priorities, including making sure important urgent items don’t get dropped, while important items that aren’t urgent still get moved steadily forward.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with a consistent approach to documenting work and following through on commitments.
* Strong technical aptitude with a high degree of proficiency in tools such as Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Docs, and other web-based applications.
* Ability to provide explanations and reasons for the choices you make and the advice you provide.
* Ability to recognize and accept responsibility for mistakes and take the steps needed to achieve a resolution.
* Demonstrated openness to coaching, feedback, and new ways of working as team processes evolve.
* Ability to maintain sensitive/confidential client information.

**Bonus Points if you have:**

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

* **Reports to:** Head of Growth Marketing
* **Location:** New York City office - 10-20% onsite/hybrid
* **Hours/Status:** Full-Time, exempt
* **Salary (USD):** $95,000-$110,000

**The role**  
  
Spektrix has an exciting opportunity for a Digital Marketing Manager to join our team!  
  
As the Digital Marketing Manager, you'll execute, measure, and optimize Spektrix’s digital marketing activity across campaigns, channels, and audiences. Working closely with Growth Marketing, Content & Campaigns, Client Marketing, Product & Partner Marketing, Events, and the Website team, you'll turn marketing strategies into targeted, measurable digital experiences that generate demand, engage clients, and move audiences to action.

You should be comfortable moving between building a campaign, defining an audience segment, reviewing conversion performance, testing an approach, and identifying what should change next.  
  
If you bring both strong execution and an analytical mindset to everything you build, we want to hear from you!

### **What You'll Do**

**Campaign Execution & Delivery:** Translate strategy briefs into end-to-end digital channel plans, automating nurture journeys, client/partner communications, product launches, and event promotions.

**Paid & Digital Channel Management:** Build, run, and optimize paid digital and social activity aligned with the growth strategy established by the Head of Growth Marketing.

**Audience Segmentation & Data Quality:** Manage audience targeting and CRM data hygiene to deliver tailored, relevant messaging and high-quality campaign builds.

**Performance Analysis, Testing & Optimization:** Implement robust tracking and attribution, lead continuous A/B testing (messaging, channels, landing pages), and use data-driven insights to refine future strategies rather than just reporting past metrics.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Website, Content, and Growth colleagues to build conversion journeys, distribute content effectively, and support co-marketing initiatives.

**Quality Assurance & Project Management:** Balance multiple concurrent projects, maintaining strict QA standards across brand consistency, accessibility, tracking, and timely delivery.

### **What You Bring**

  

* Demonstrated experience in digital marketing, demand generation, growth marketing, or a related role, ideally within a B2B environment.
* Hands-on experience building and executing multi-channel digital marketing campaigns.
* Strong working knowledge of email marketing, marketing automation, audience segmentation, and nurture journeys.
* Experience managing or executing paid digital campaigns, including paid social.
* Experience with campaign tracking, analytics, attribution, and performance reporting.
* Ability to interpret marketing data, identify meaningful insights, and translate those insights into specific actions and optimizations.
* Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms and an understanding of how campaign, contact, and engagement data flow between systems.
* Understanding of conversion optimization and testing methodologies.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when managing campaign setup, segmentation, tracking, links, and communications.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines, including content, design, web, product marketing, client marketing, events, and sales.
* Strong judgment and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify gaps, question assumptions, and recommend improvements rather than relying solely on established processes.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of outcomes, and proactively identify what needs to happen next.

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Company paid medical, dental and vision insurance
* Generous Paid Time Off benefits, including
  + 21 days of PTO (vacation, personal time, whatever you choose to use it for)
  + 14 paid holidays
  + 10 Paid Sick Days
* 401(k) with 4% employer match
* Two paid volunteering days per year
* Professional development opportunities
* Flexible working with support for WFH setup and equipment
* Month-long Paid Sabbatical after 5 years of service
* Free snacks, drinks and breakfast items in our offices
* Varied range of regular social activities throughout the year

While many Spektrix team members live near one of our offices (NYC, London, or Manchester), remote/non-local team members work from home *most* of the time, and all team members work from home at least *some* of the time!  
  
We provide reasonable support and all the hardware you need to get started, but we do require that you have the have the following in place to work from home:

* A quiet working space at home where you can consistently take video calls without interruption
* A strong, reliable internet connection that supports your participation in video calls and access to our systems and service

**Working At The Office**  
For team members who are 'local' to NYC, a stipend is offered for each day you work on-site. Think of it as our way of easing potential commute related costs (but no need to prove it - this is a perk we offer for days worked onsite, regardless of how you choose to get there).  
  
**Equal Opportunities**  
Spektrix is an equal opportunity employer. We recruit regardless of race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age or disability status and look to employ from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences.  
  
Spektrix is committed to creating an inclusive work environment, where our team members are supported in expressing themselves and delivering their best work. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

jobs.description:
**Fulton County Clerk of Superior and Magistrate Courts**  
**FLSA Status:** Non-Exempt  
**Grade:** 14  
**Salary Range:** $50,498.00 (Non-Negotiable)

**Closing Date:** **11****/02/2026**

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Official Classification Summary**

The purpose of this classification is to serve as the office manager and primary administrative support resource for a major division or department.

Administrative Coordinators are broadly responsible for coordinating administrative, operational, financial, procurement, records management, customer service, and departmental support functions. Employees in this classification exercise independent judgment, coordinate multiple work activities, maintain records, process financial and purchasing transactions, support departmental leadership, and serve as liaisons between departments, staff, vendors, and external stakeholders.

Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned in accordance with the Fulton County Administrative Coordinator I classification specification.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Essential Functions**

  

Serves as liaison between the assigned department and other departments/divisions, staff members, County officials, the public, community leaders, outside agencies, or other individuals or organizations for the distribution and receipt of routine information; interacts with various officials and dignitaries involving sensitive client relations; conveys information among division/department personnel; circulates documentation to appropriate departments.

Provides administrative/secretarial support for management and/or staff of assigned department/division: relieves management staff of routine administrative tasks; screens telephone calls, mail, e-mail, and other communications and initiates appropriate action/response; records and transcribes dictation; types, composes, edits, or proofreads various documentation; maintains calendars and schedules meetings, appointments, interviews, or other activities; coordinates travel arrangements, accommodations, conference registrations, or related plans for department staff.

Processes documentation pertaining to budget or general financial management; reviews invoices for accuracy, matches with purchase orders; enters budget data into computer; assists with budget preparation; provides budgetary input and assists in forecasting revenues/expenditures; enters daily revenue into computer and generates revenue reports; reviews monthly budget analysis reports; monitors expenditures to ensure compliance with approved budget; processes budget transfers as needed; reconciles payable records with Finance Department records prepares bank deposits; coordinates internal accounting activities; maintains current balances for accounts; and maintains departmental petty cash funds.

Processes purchasing documentation: reviews purchase requisitions and verifies availability of budgeted funds; prepares purchase orders and forwards data to appropriate departments; obtains competitive price quotes; orders materials under blanket purchase orders.; reviews invoices, purchase orders, or other documents for accuracy; research discrepancies, assigns proper accounting/budgetary codes, obtains proper signatures, and forwards for payment; maintains files and records.

Receives and sorts incoming documentation and materials: sends/receives documentation; distributes/delivers incoming faxes, subpoenas, mail, or other documentation to appropriate personnel; sorts, organizes, opens, and/or distributes incoming mail; signs for incoming packages and delivers to appropriate personnel; processes outgoing mail; copies and distributes forms, reports, correspondence, schedules, agendas, or other documentation.  
  
Performs customer service functions in person, by telephone, and by mail: provides information/assistance regarding department/division services, procedures, fees, or other issues; responds to routine questions or complaints; researches problems/complaints and initiates problem resolution; receives payments for various fees, fines, or services: records transactions, posts payments, and issues receipts; balances cash drawers; prepares revenues for deposit and forwards as appropriate.  
  
Provides administrative support for boards, committees, or other meetings: prepares meeting agendas, packets, and related documentation; coordinates meeting rooms/facilities, equipment, and refreshments; notifies participants of scheduled meetings; submits public notices to newspapers, property owners, or others as required; prepares and distributes agendas, meeting notices, meeting packets, and related documentation; records and transcribes meeting minutes; distributes meeting minutes to appropriate individuals; maintains official records.  
  
Maintains department webpage, social media, and online enrollment; uploads pictures, schedules, brochures and other events and information; adds upcoming events to calendar; posts news and announcements; enters and maintains information regarding classes and fees; processes registrations, memberships and rentals; runs reports and prints class lists; assists customers with creating user accounts and site navigation as needed.  
  
Coordinates arrangements for various meetings; notifies participants of scheduled meetings; prepares meeting notices, agendas, and meeting packets; coordinates room reservations, setup, refreshments, and equipment required for meetings; attends meetings; records and/or transcribes meeting minutes; distributes documentation; maintains records.

**About the Business**

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Insurance vertical, we provide customers with solutions and decision tools that combine public and industry specific content with advanced technology and analytics to assist them in evaluating and predicting risk and enhancing operational efficiency. Our insurance risk solutions help drive better data-driven decisions across the insurance policy lifecycle, all while reducing risk. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at https://risk.lexisnexis.com/insurance.

  

**About our Team**

Our team values attention to detail, reliability, and teamwork while following established processes and quality standards. You’ll work in a supportive, on-site environment where you can build your skills through hands-on experience, training, and ongoing development.

  
  

**About the Role**

You will support accurate and accessible information by entering data, managing files and documents, and preparing content using established processes. This is a full-time, on-site role working Wednesday through Sunday, with scheduled weekday and weekend shifts.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Administration - Conduct data entry into company systems, and file information using established procedures to ensure information is accurate and accessible.
* Work Scheduling and Allocation - Work according to an assigned schedule.
* Document Management - File records or documents as instructed.
* Document Preparation - Input content into standard templates. Also take responsibility for collating materials and photocopying them.
* Data Collection and Analysis - Perform basic data entry tasks.
* Data Management - File and retrieve documents from company filing systems.
* Operational Compliance - Follow a straightforward mandatory procedure to ensure that work is carried out to the required quality standards and/or to ensure adherence to external regulatory codes and internal codes of conduct.
* Personal Capability Building - Develop and maintain excellent skills by participating in assessment and development planning activities as well as formal and informal training and coaching.

**Requirements**

* Professional work-based experience (3 months+)
* Position is full time, with a 40-hour work week. The role is for Wednesday-Sunday, with Mondays and Tuesdays off. Shift is 8AM-4:30PM Wednesday-Friday, and 7AM-3:30PM on weekends.
* Position is on site full time. There is no hybrid work available for this role.
* Must be able to work some holidays.
* Overtime on off days may be available, on an as needed basis.

We have been a family-owned and operated business since our start in 1964. Over the years, we have grown rapidly, and we now have the privilege of servicing 16 states. jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious mission: to **inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together.**

More than 1/3 of all food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet. 10% of greenhouse gas emissions come from food waste and loss.

Through our marketplace app, we connect businesses that have unsold, surplus food, with consumers who can buy and enjoy it at a discount of the retail value. Alongside our marketplace app, we create educational tools, explore new business solutions, and influence legislation to help reduce food waste.

We’re looking for an exceptional **Enterprise Customer Success Manager** to join the team at Too Good To Go to lead the US partnerships.

**Your role**

As a **Enterprise Customer Success Manager**, you will play a pivotal role in driving the success of our most strategic partnerships. You will be responsible for managing a portfolio of key account partners, building and sustaining strong relationships with senior stakeholders. With a proactive, consultative, and data-driven approach, you will identify opportunities to increase meals saved, grow account value, and expand product adoption. By deeply understanding each partner’s business challenges, you will deliver tailored solutions aligned with our value drivers, ensuring long-term mutual success.

In this role, you will oversee the full account lifecycle from onboarding through to ongoing optimization. You will lead the development and execution of strategic account plans, conduct regular performance reviews such as Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and focus on driving retention at both HQ and store levels. Your ability to effectively pitch our full product portfolio will be key to introducing new categories and enhancing partner engagement. Collaborating closely with Sales, Store Operations, and Marketing teams, you will ensure strong store coverage, optimize supply quality, and deliver a seamless partner experience, all in support of our mission to reduce food waste.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Drive Account Growth**: Own the health and success of your customers from launch through expansion, with a focus on optimizing meals saved.
* **Analyze and Manage Risks**: Analyze store data to forecast meal savings accurately. Identify, communicate, and manage store risks proactively throughout the year, and lead in developing resolution strategies.
* **Provide Consultative Support:** Offer expert recommendations on food-saving practices
* **Lead Client Meetings:** Regularly lead and present at client meetings, both in-person and via video conference, to ensure alignment and progress.
* **Onboard and Train:** Oversee the execution of client programs, ensuring they are implemented effectively and deliver the expected value. Train new stores, collaborating with both store-level contacts and senior stakeholders to ensure a smooth process.
* **Manage Portfolio Autonomously**: Take ownership of your portfolio, maintaining strong relationships and meeting business KPIs independently.
* **Enhance Team Scalability:** Contribute to the scalability of the key account team through effective documentation and process optimization.
* **Advocacy and Impact:** Act as the voice of the client within Too Good To Go, advocating for their needs and contributing to our mission of reducing food waste through successful partnerships.

As a proactive, organized and experienced “quarterback”, you will excel in the following areas:

* **Communication:** Polished and effective communication with stakeholders and team members to ensure that we deliver a high quality client engagement with our key account.
* **Value & Solution Selling**: Experienced in solving complex business pains through solution selling, using data to influence decisions and successfully expanding partnerships through targeted upselling and cross-selling.
* **Account Strategy**: Effectively manages pipelines and portfolios, driving partner engagement and loyalty while setting benchmarks through strategic, collaborative account leadership.
* **Technical Skills:** Experience with sales CRM, project management and analysis tools like.. Salesforce, Ninja, Looker, Asana, as is a high competency with google drive (sheets, docs, decks).
* **Problem-Solving Skills**: Critical thinking and adaptability are essential for identifying and addressing issues as they arise during the project.
* **Project Management:** Meeting monthly meals saved milestones is critical, so time management skills and the ability to work in multiple stages of launch for different regions is imperative.
* **Organizational Skills:** Effective documentation and resource management to ensure will be critical to the successful launch and continued rollout of our key partner.
* **Cool Cucumber:** The ideal candidate is an individual who not only loves a challenge but also thrives in the face of occasional ambiguity.

**Requirements**

* Previous experience in sales, customer success, business development, or account management - specifically selling into VP+. Industry experience that translates well include: food, hospitality, media and technology.
* Strong accountability and demonstrated ability to effectively manage and meet key performance indicators (KPIs)
* Master communicator, you know when to speak, you know how to listen, and you know how to engage a whole room and keep their attention.
* Strong commercial acumen and appropriate assertiveness to drive deals forward.
* Proactive, solution-focused mindset with a strong emphasis on growth and curiosity.
* Polished, detail-oriented professional with a humble and collaborative attitude.
* Data analysis skills with raw data to create performance reports and projections to identify and understand trends, opportunities and issues.
* Enthusiasm for sustainability, food waste reduction, and environmental issues.
* Experience with value-based selling and/or MEDDICC methodology (preferred).

jobs.description:
Are you energized by creating new business opportunities and opening doors? Do you thrive in a high-activity environment where your hustle directly drives your income?

If so, we’d love to hear from you.

### **Who We Are:**

Pacific Energy Concepts is North America’s most innovative energy optimization company, delivering customized LED lighting, advanced controls, EV Charging, and Energy Monitoring solutions that help our partners run efficient, save money, and reduce their carbon footprint.

Trusted by 5,000+ organizations including Costco, IKEA, and Alaska Airlines, we’ve spent 17 years delivering results. We work hard, celebrate wins together, and live by core values- Build to Last, Play to Win, Push the Envelope, and Do the Right Thing that reflect the people we are and the people we hire.

### **Why PEC?**

* We’re 100% privately owned. No shareholders or PE backing, meaning we think long-term, not quarter-to-quarter.

* Our senior sales leaders are genuine experts in the field, each with more than a decade of experience and every one of them was developed from within PEC.
* We operate with a proven playbook backed by a world-class training and support program, giving every member of the sales team the best possible chance for success.
* Our leaders are in the trenches every day. If a deal can be sold, they’ll help you get it sold. We believe in a real team approach where everyone is incentivized to help each other.
* Our operations and support staff ensure we consistently over-deliver for customers so you can feel confident in what you’re selling.
* We’re a values-driven company that invests heavily in the culture and well-being of every team member. We build trust and alignment with everything we do.

### **The Role**

We’re looking for four new Business Development Representatives to join our Chicago office. In this role, you’ll be responsible for generating new sales opportunities for our Sales Engineers through a mix of marketing-generated leads and outbound prospecting/cold calling.

When we say “Cold Calling,” we mean highly targeted leads, not a shotgun approach. You’ll be equipped with a suite of top-tier prospecting tools to maximize your efficiency and conversion rate. Expect to make 50–100 outbound dials per day, depending on your conversion rates.

  
  
**Requirements**  

* 1-3 years of sales experience in an outbound environment, B2B preferred.
* A genuine love of learning. Our solutions can be complex, and we want someone who is motivated to become a true expert in our field.
* The ability to explain complicated ideas in simple, compelling ways.
* A coachable mindset. Our playbook works and those who embrace it consistently exceed their targets and earn exceptional income.
* A passion for outbound prospecting and lead generation.

### **Compensation & Details**

* Base salary: $50,000, with an expected first-year OTE of $70,000–$90,000.
* This is an in-office role based out of our Chicago office (River North).

  
**Benefits**

Working at PEC comes with great perks. We’re a collaborative group who are passionate about our work and invested in our team members’ well-being.

* 4% 401k matching
* Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance covered at 90%
* Fully paid Long/Short-Term Disability and Life Insurance
* Open PTO
* A killer culture with regular team trips, events, and lunches (be sure to ask about our 80’s-style Ski Trip)

If you’re an outbound hunter who wants the ability to let your efforts directly impact your earnings, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Independent Sales Representative – Audio Advertising & Creative Services
jobs.description:
Somewhere, a business owner is about to approve another ad nobody will remember. We’d like you to interrupt that meeting. Politely, preferably. Nugget Radio is looking for independent sales representatives who can spot an opportunity, start a genuine conversation and help a business find its voice. Sometimes that voice comes with a ridiculously catchy chorus. Great Music. Strange Company. Forever Free. That’s our station. Behind it is Rafa Brands LLC, and we’re building a creative-services business around original musical advertising, good ideas and people willing to do something a little different. WHAT YOU’LL BE SELLING We’re starting with custom jingles and musical advertisements, plus Nugget Radio placement opportunities under approved campaign terms. As our offerings develop, there will also be website, merchandise-store and social-content packages to discuss with the right clients. A neighborhood café. An artist. A pet business. A contractor with a great service and an advertisement that sounds like everyone else’s. There are plenty of conversations worth having. YOUR SIDE OF THE MICROPHONE Find businesses. Learn what they need. Show them relevant examples. Explain our approved offers. Follow up. Bring in paying clients with a clear brief so we can deliver what was promised. You can meet people locally, use your existing relationships, pick up the phone or prospect online. You don’t need to sit in our office. There isn’t an attendance prize. Keep your leads organized and your promises accurate. Final pricing, scope and unusual requests go through us. We won’t ask you to invent listener numbers, guarantee somebody’s sales or sell services we aren’t ready to deliver. YOU MIGHT FIT HERE IF… **You can talk with a business owner like a person, not a sales script wearing shoes.**  You know how to listen, explain value and ask for the business. **You follow up without needing someone to chase you.**  You’re comfortable with basic digital tools and keeping useful records. **You enjoy music, creative ideas and helping independent businesses get noticed.**  You understand that building a client base takes actual work. Sales experience is useful. Existing business relationships are useful. A résumé containing the word “synergy” seventeen times is not required. LET’S TALK MONEY This is a commission-based contract opportunity, not a salaried position. Earnings depend on sales. We’re an early-stage business, so we’re not going to dress up a guess as a guaranteed annual income. You’ll receive written terms covering commission rates, eligible sales and payment timing before work begins. Customers pay the business directly; we handle billing and creative production. We’re also building in two things that matter: **Sales-training assistance funded from a portion of business sales, separate from your commission.**  Referral rewards for introducing additional sales representatives to the team. The budgets, rewards and qualifying terms will be defined in writing. Flexible scheduling is part of the arrangement. WHERE YOU FIT Chicago is our initial recruiting focus, but we’re open to discussing other territories. Local visits, phone conversations and online outreach can all have a place here. INTERESTED? Tell us what you’ve sold, which kinds of businesses you understand and how you would start a conversation about an ad that’s actually a song. We’ll bring the music. Bring your curiosity, your follow-through and a little personality. Nugget Radio · Rafa Brands LLC

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program

Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Production Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:

**Job Summary:**

The Operations Coordinator provides administrative, analytical, and systems support to the Plant Director and Sr. Operations Manager. This role serves as a central coordinator for operational processes, ensuring follow-through on actions, maintaining management systems, organizing critical information, and supporting operational decision-making through reporting and analysis.

The position is responsible for coordinating production schedules, documenting meetings, maintaining action registers, supporting root cause analysis processes, auditing management systems, and preparing reports that enable the leadership team to execute effectively.

**Responsibilities of the Position:**

**Operations Support**

* Support the Plant Director and Sr. Operations Manager with daily operational coordination.
* Maintain calendars, meeting schedules, and operational priorities as assigned.
* Prepare reports, presentations, and operational communications.
* Coordinate and track department deliverables.

**Production Scheduling Support**

* Assist in creating, maintaining, and communicating production schedules.
* Monitor schedule changes and update stakeholders.
* Identify scheduling conflicts and escalate risks.
* Maintain schedule documentation and revisions.

**Daily Management System Administration**

* Maintain Daily Management boards and associated reporting.
* Ensure KPIs are updated accurately and on time.
* Support preparation of leadership meetings and review materials.
* Track performance trends and identify missing information.

**Action Management**

* Capture actions from operational meetings.
* Maintain centralized action registers.
* Track due dates, owners, and completion status.
* Drive accountability through routine follow-up.

**Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Coordination**

* Maintain RCA tracking systems.
* Ensure investigations are completed according to expectations.
* Monitor corrective actions and effectiveness reviews.
* Compile RCA summaries and trend reports.

**Data Analysis & Reporting**

* Collect, organize, and analyze operational data.
* Prepare recurring reports for leadership review.
* Develop dashboards and performance summaries.
* Investigate operational trends and support special projects.

**Auditing & Compliance**

* Audit operational systems for compliance to standards.
* Verify completion of required documentation.
* Identify gaps and opportunities for improvement.
* Provide audit findings and follow-up recommendations.

**Continuous Improvement Support**

* Support implementation of operational improvement initiatives.
* Maintain project tracking logs.
* Coordinate project updates and status reporting.
* Assist with standardization efforts across departments.

Other duties as assigned by Management.

Requirements:

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Ability to influence without authority
* Ability to ensure actions are documented, assigned, and completed
* Ability to maintain accuracy of reports, schedules, and management systems
* Ability to identify issues and follow through until they are resolved
* Ability to turn information into clear updates and actionable insights
* Ability to help move projects and initiatives forward quickly
* Bilingual in Spanish preferred, but not required

**Education and Experience:**

* Associate degree, bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
* Experience supporting operations, manufacturing, scheduling, project coordination, reporting, or administrative functions
* Experience working with Excel and other Microsoft Office applications
* Experience in a manufacturing environment
* Experience with production scheduling, reporting, or performance tracking
* Experience supporting continuous improvement, audits, or problem-solving activities

**Physical Requirements:**

* Regular walking through manufacturing and warehouse areas.
* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods during audits and observations.
* Ability to use computers and office equipment frequently throughout the day.
* Occasionally lift up to 20 pounds.
* Ability to wear required PPE while entering GMP environments.

new_jobs.title: Independent Sales Representative – Audio Advertising & Creative Services
new_jobs.description:
Somewhere, a business owner is about to approve another ad nobody will remember. We’d like you to interrupt that meeting. Politely, preferably. Nugget Radio is looking for independent sales representatives who can spot an opportunity, start a genuine conversation and help a business find its voice. Sometimes that voice comes with a ridiculously catchy chorus. Great Music. Strange Company. Forever Free. That’s our station. Behind it is Rafa Brands LLC, and we’re building a creative-services business around original musical advertising, good ideas and people willing to do something a little different. WHAT YOU’LL BE SELLING We’re starting with custom jingles and musical advertisements, plus Nugget Radio placement opportunities under approved campaign terms. As our offerings develop, there will also be website, merchandise-store and social-content packages to discuss with the right clients. A neighborhood café. An artist. A pet business. A contractor with a great service and an advertisement that sounds like everyone else’s. There are plenty of conversations worth having. YOUR SIDE OF THE MICROPHONE Find businesses. Learn what they need. Show them relevant examples. Explain our approved offers. Follow up. Bring in paying clients with a clear brief so we can deliver what was promised. You can meet people locally, use your existing relationships, pick up the phone or prospect online. You don’t need to sit in our office. There isn’t an attendance prize. Keep your leads organized and your promises accurate. Final pricing, scope and unusual requests go through us. We won’t ask you to invent listener numbers, guarantee somebody’s sales or sell services we aren’t ready to deliver. YOU MIGHT FIT HERE IF… **You can talk with a business owner like a person, not a sales script wearing shoes.**  You know how to listen, explain value and ask for the business. **You follow up without needing someone to chase you.**  You’re comfortable with basic digital tools and keeping useful records. **You enjoy music, creative ideas and helping independent businesses get noticed.**  You understand that building a client base takes actual work. Sales experience is useful. Existing business relationships are useful. A résumé containing the word “synergy” seventeen times is not required. LET’S TALK MONEY This is a commission-based contract opportunity, not a salaried position. Earnings depend on sales. We’re an early-stage business, so we’re not going to dress up a guess as a guaranteed annual income. You’ll receive written terms covering commission rates, eligible sales and payment timing before work begins. Customers pay the business directly; we handle billing and creative production. We’re also building in two things that matter: **Sales-training assistance funded from a portion of business sales, separate from your commission.**  Referral rewards for introducing additional sales representatives to the team. The budgets, rewards and qualifying terms will be defined in writing. Flexible scheduling is part of the arrangement. WHERE YOU FIT Chicago is our initial recruiting focus, but we’re open to discussing other territories. Local visits, phone conversations and online outreach can all have a place here. INTERESTED? Tell us what you’ve sold, which kinds of businesses you understand and how you would start a conversation about an ad that’s actually a song. We’ll bring the music. Bring your curiosity, your follow-through and a little personality. Nugget Radio · Rafa Brands LLC

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program

Work Location: On the road
